prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce ONE finished standalone PNG game asset for Master of Orion — Reborn. Filename: race-klackon-figure.png. Requested dimensions 2048x3072, 2:3. Input image: approved race leader portrait, visual reference for original species design, believable materials, costume identity and lighting.
Race lore and art direction:
7 · Klackon — Kholdan — rust red / olive
Game role: the hive workforce. Strengths: every colonist produces double, cheap construction, nearly no rebellion. Weaknesses: short-range drives, insular and mistrusted.
Body & dress: large ant-like insectoids: glossy dark-brown/rust chitin, big compound eyes, mandibles, segmented antennae, fine bristles, multiple limbs (keep a humanoid-ish upright bust). Plain uniform worker-caste collars, caste glyph plates, tool-belts; almost no personal ornament — individuality is rare and suspicious.
Surroundings: an orderly hive-city: honeycomb corridors lit amber, ranks of identical stations, pheromone-vent glows, conveyor "trails" along walls, vast factory floors; clean, repetitive, efficient; clay/resin textures mixed with industrial steel.
Personality: orderly, impersonal, courteous in a mechanical way. Moods: flat neutrality → antennae-twitching alarm.
Hooks: a queen-caste chamber glimpsed beyond, rank shown by antenna rings, identical figures behind the speaker.
Asset purpose: Full-body race leader. EXACT SAME individual, face, species, coloring, collar insignia and uniform design as reference, extended into full formal dress with accurate species anatomy including wings or tail where applicable. Dignified iconic pose, 2-3 small culturally telling props.
Composition: CRITICAL: use a plain nearly black studio background with only a faint dim floor, NO detailed room, NO planet window, NO furniture. Visual treatment: photorealistic cinematic hard sci-fi concept still, serious prestige drama, worn lived-in industrial materials, 85mm portrait lens language where appropriate, strong key from left, restrained race-colored rim, deep shadows, subtle film grain, muted filmic grade. Match reference realism and species identity. ONE dominant race accent color. No text, captions, readable glyphs or equations, numbers, watermark, logos, borders, interface, real-world flags or symbols. Small non-text original costume insignia from reference may remain. Avoid cartoon, anime, cel shading, toy, plastic, waxy skin, cute mascot, oversized eyes, rainbow saturation, fantasy armor, medieval costume, malformed hands or duplicated limbs. Full frame is one coherent scene, never a collage.
